scope: Deterministic contract counterexamples; these are not recovered scores or a claim that each triggered a particular network episode.

cases.source_level_defect: The ledger can demand a true stock flag that the listing-evidence checker cannot represent.
The key checker requires exact or nested word sets; semantic bindings cannot bridge synonyms.
Substring matching turns a legitimate semantic equivalence into a definitive mismatch.
Unavailable and rejected are conflated; only a separate bounded adjudication path can reopen the result.
The decision packet and evidence validator disagree on which exact text was supplied.
The independent guard can veto a valid purchase using an ineligible cheaper subtype.
The no-candidate branch cannot distinguish proven absence from insufficient search evidence.
